standard-dialogue.npc: Are you here to fight the lizardmen? Be careful - they're fierce!

steps.npc: The lizardmen are the bane of Kourend. I'm not much for history, but the Shayzien Army have been fighting them off for as long as anyone can remember.
They can be aggressive, and they've got something nasty in their bite that can make you pretty ill.

options.text: Why are you up here instead of fighting?

steps.player: Why are you up here instead of fighting?

steps.npc: I got a bite from a lizardman. I'm all cured, but I'm not going down there again until I feel stronger, otherwise I'll be no use in the fight.

options.text: Do you know how many I've killed already?

steps.player: Do you know how many I've killed already?

steps.npc: The Shayzien records say you've killed [COUNT] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [COUNT] were lizardman shamans.

kill-count.npc: The Shayzien records say you've killed [COUNT] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [COUNT] were lizardman shamans.

canyon-count-east.npc: I see no adventurers in the canyon to the east.
